provenance.notes: Microsoft publishes no quota for the Webmaster API's statistics calls (GetQueryStats, GetPageStats, GetRankAndTrafficStats): searched on 2026-11-10, only the URL and content submission quotas are documented (per site, by GetUrlSubmissionQuota), and Bing throttles past an unpublished threshold: rate limits unknown. The data is the site owner's own statistics; the terms read say nothing of commercial use, caching, storage or redistribution. An API key from Bing Webmaster Tools' settings.
